properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Sub-title, drawn under the title in the muted text colour.

properties.name: titleAlign
properties.description: Title alignment over the plot: `start` (left), `center`, or `end` (right).

properties.name: stack
properties.description: Default stacking is `'normal'` (additive).

properties.name: lineWidth
properties.description: Line stroke width in px, for every series. Per-series `series[].lineWidth` wins.

properties.name: markSize
properties.description: Marker RADIUS in px, for every series. Per-series `series[].markSize` wins.

properties.name: locale
properties.description:
BCP-47 locale for the DEFAULT number / date formatting (axis ticks,
tooltip values, screen-reader table). Empty follows the browser; an
explicit `valueFormatter` always wins.

properties.name: tooltipRenderer
properties.description: Replace the tooltip's content. See `md-line-chart`'s `tooltipRenderer`.

properties.name: noAnimation
properties.description: Disable all animation (shorthand for `animation="none"`).

properties.name: animation
properties.description: Entry-animation variant: `expressive` (default), `grow`, `fade`, `draw`, or `none`.

properties.name: animationDuration
properties.description: Entry-animation duration override in ms (≤ 0 disables).

properties.name: fillOpacity
properties.description: Fill opacity for the gradient (0..1).

properties.name: showLine
properties.description:
Draw the line on top of each area's fill. Default `true`. Set `false` for a
fill-only area — useful when `fillOpacity` is high (a fully-opaque fill is the
same colour as the line, so the line reads as part of it). A per-series
`series[].stroke` still wins over this.

properties.name: grid
properties.description: Gridlines: horizontal (y ticks), vertical (x ticks), both, or none.

properties.name: inverted
properties.description:
Transpose the axes: the category / time axis runs down the side and values
run across the bottom. Suits long category names (they read horizontally
instead of rotated) and quantities naturally read as depth — altitude,
ocean depth, a drill core. `stack` applies as usual, along the value axis.

properties.name: seriesLabels
properties.description:
Label each series at its last point, so the name follows the end of the
band — for racing / progression charts.

properties.name: summary
properties.description:
Replaces the generated `aria-label` outright. The default summary is
assembled in English ("Traffic, Area chart, with 3 series, from Jan to
Dec."); rather than translate it piecewise, hand over the whole sentence
built in your own language.

properties.name: tableLabels
properties.type: { x?: string; index?: string; series?: string; truncated?: string }
properties.description:
Translatable chrome for the screen-reader data table. `%shown%` and
`%total%` are substituted in `truncated`.

properties.name: labelEmpty
properties.description: Message shown when `series` is empty. The `empty` slot overrides it.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Show the loading overlay instead of the plot.

properties.name: loadingLabel
properties.description: Text (and the spinner's accessible name) for the loading overlay.

properties.name: labelZoomStart
properties.description: Accessible name for the zoom slider's start thumb.

properties.name: labelZoomEnd
properties.description: Accessible name for the zoom slider's end thumb.

properties.name: axisTicks
properties.description: Draw small perpendicular tick marks on the axes.

properties.name: showLabels
properties.description: Print each point's value as a data label beside its marker.

properties.name: labelPlot
properties.default: 'Chart data. Use the arrow keys to move between points, Home and End for the first and last, Escape to leave.'
properties.defaultValue: Chart data. Use the arrow keys to move between points, Home and End for the first and last, Escape to leave.
properties.description:
Instructions announced when the plot receives keyboard focus. The plot is
focusable so a keyboard user can walk the data with the arrow keys; this
is what tells them so.

properties.name: labelPoint
properties.description:
Template for the live announcement as keyboard focus moves. `%x%` is the
axis value, `%values%` the series readings at it.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

events.name: mdLegendClick
events.detail: { seriesIndex: number; seriesId?: string; selected: boolean }

events.name: mdZoom
events.detail: { startIndex: number; endIndex: number; reset: boolean }

cssParts.name: footer

cssParts.name: zoom-window

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-block-size
cssProperties.description: Explicit chart height, overriding the aspect ratio (default: auto)

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-min-block-size
cssProperties.description: Floor the chart height never drops below (density-aware)

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-aspect-ratio

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-padding

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-shape
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the chart surface (density-aware)

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-zoom-size

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-zoom-track-color
cssProperties.description: Zoom slider track colour (md-slider inactive track)

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-zoom-window-color
cssProperties.description: Zoom slider selected-window colour (md-slider active track)

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-zoom-handle-color
cssProperties.description: Zoom slider thumb + drag-band edge colour

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-empty-background
cssProperties.description: Empty-state overlay fill (defaults to the chart background)

cssProperties.name: --md-area-chart-empty-icon-size
cssProperties.description: Size of an icon slotted into the empty state (default: 40px)

diagnostics.message: Callable props require target-specific callback signatures.
Native layout measurement must replace ResizeObserver.
getBoundingClientRect depends on browser semantics and requires a native adapter.
querySelector depends on browser semantics and requires a native adapter.
shadowRoot depends on browser semantics and requires a native adapter.
Computed CSS must become native theme/layout values.
DOM cancellation, bubbling and composed paths are not implied by a native callback.

name: Area Chart
description: A trend with cumulative volume. A line chart with the region under the curve filled — stacked by default, so composition over time is the natural reading. Also does streamgraphs and low/high range bands.

notes: Native Canvas area fill. Linear, unstacked, single axis. Tap probes first visible series. Browser advanced chart features listed unsupported.

Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, form association, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.
Native Canvas baseline: index-based linear plotting and simple hit selection. Advanced scales, curves, stacking, zoom, exact source tooltip/hit-test/event payload parity remain incomplete.
